summary: Mike Romano led a design review of the Protect scheduler rewrite with Nina Kowalski, Chris Lee and Sofia Petrov ahead of production rollout. Canary load tests at 2x P95 scale cut backup queue time from 47 minutes to about 6, with concurrent dispatch eliminating lock contention. Sofia presented the root cause of Silverline's April snapshot corruption: a race condition in async dedup let index entries be written before chunk data flushed, so backups reported success while restores failed, which Chris compared to the Detect health-check lesson. The team made checksum verification after flush and daily 1% automated restore verification mandatory release gates, approved a three-week staged rollout (5%, 25%, 100%) with automatic rollback, and agreed to resist sales pressure from the new Comply plus Protect bundle. Multi-region replication requested by Vanta Health is likely to slip to early Q4, so Nina will ask product to scope a Q3 single-region early access.
